about:
ESC Supply operates from Mobile, Alabama, where it was founded in 1956. The company remains a privately held wholesale distributor; the INPUT does not disclose founders or ownership structure.

The firm stocks thousands of low-voltage products for immediate shipment nationwide. Its catalog spans security systems, fire alarms and accessories, closed-circuit television (CCTV) equipment, access control hardware, and related low-voltage components. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

The distributor serves contractors, integrators, and resellers who specify and install security, fire, and surveillance infrastructure. Typical customers include electrical and low-voltage contractors, alarm dealers, and systems integrators across the United States.

ESC Supply emphasizes its nationwide in-stock inventory and a service model described as “second to none,” positioning rapid fulfillment and technical support as its primary differentiators.
